verification_notes: --write run from agent-system/extensions/literature/scripts/literature-fidelity-audit.sh (source-store path, not the stale .claude/ deploy copy). Backup created and byte-verified at ~/Projects/Literature/index.json.bak.20260902-052324 before the write proceeded. Entry-level id-keyed diff of parent entries (pre-write backup vs post-write index.json) shows exactly 29 provenance_fidelity transitions, every one attributable: 10 verified_conversion->unverified_scan_source + 1 UNSET(goldblatt_1989)->unverified_scan_source (the scan-source de-certification, all 11 flagged directories covered, exceeding the >=9 acceptance bar); 7 unverified_conversion->no_source_pdf + 3 unverified_conversion->verified_conversion (the 10 orphaned-value self-heals, confirmed zero unverified_conversion entries remain anywhere in the corpus); 8 verified_conversion->no_source_pdf (independently verified: all 8 directories genuinely have no PDF/DJVU on disk today -- a real corpus data-lifecycle change unrelated to defects a/b/c, not a regression, since no_source_pdf is a safe non-quarantined resting state). The remaining 150 of the 179 write-summary 'changed' count are combining_mark_checked/dropped/missing field population (an orthogonal, pre-existing signal being correctly populated for the first time under this run) plus 11 minor word_ratio refreshes on directories whose classification was already correct -- neither touches provenance_fidelity. literature-search.sh 'deliberative stit' (no --include-unverified) still returns results post-write (horty_belnap_1995_deliberative-stit, no_source_pdf, unquarantined). literature-briefing.sh per-repo mode, tested via a throwaway single-entry specs/literature-index.json pointing at burgess_1982_i (now unverified_scan_source) and a scaffold copy at the correct two-directory-up nesting depth (the source-store copy's PROJECT_ROOT derivation assumes deployed-at-.claude/scripts/ nesting, so a direct in-place run cannot resolve specs/ correctly -- documented for future runs), confirmed the exact [UNVERIFIED - provenance_fidelity: unverified_scan_source - ...] marker is emitted. Both throwaway test artifacts (specs/literature-index.json, the scaffold dir) were deleted immediately after verification; git status confirms no residue. .claude/ deploy tree remains stale until the user redeploys the literature extension -- out of scope for this task, noted here per the plan's explicit instruction.
